item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 10 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Cawayan), #Romblon(Cajidiocan, Magdiwang, Ferrol, Odiongan, SantaMaria and Concepcion) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(SanJose, SantaFe, Looc and Alcantara) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
